title: Polycentric Governance Architecture
subtitle: Structural blueprint for distributed authority and voluntary coordination
description: Foundational framework enabling coordination across autonomous governance centers without centralized command—from ancient Indigenous confederacies to modern internet governance, proven architecture for addressing complex challenges through distributed authority, subsidiarity, and voluntary cooperation.
